sources.title: Ferrexpo’s quarterly output falls on production halt, export constraints
evidence: Iron ore pellet producer Ferrexpo (LON: FXPO) reported a 19% sequential drop in third-quarter output on Wednesday, pressured by a production halt and constrained export capacity as access to Ukrainian ports remained severely restricted.
Total commercial production fell to 779,975 tons in the three-month period ended September 30, from 963,409 tons in the second quarter.
In August, Ukraine-focused Ferrexpo temporarily suspended production due to liquidity issues and export disruptions in the Black Sea stemming from the Russian war in Ukraine.
The miner restarted one pellet line in September

Ferrexpo said it was in advanced talks for a secured trade finance facility, but finalising the deal has been delayed by disruptions to its Black Sea export route and its ability to deliver shipments.

sources.title: Global diesel shortages could persist well into 2027, IEA says
evidence: Global diesel markets could remain tight well into next year
Combined losses of diesel exports from the Middle East and Russia totalled 1.3 million barrels per day in September
That represents about 4.5% of the global diesel and gas oil demand the agency forecasts for this year.
The global gasoil supply and demand balance will remain tight in the first half of 2027, and ease in the second half
